title: Friendship Formation
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child discusses why good friends matter and the teachings of 1 Corinthians 15:33 (bad company corrupts good character), Proverbs 13:20 (walk with the wise and become wise) and Proverbs 16:28-29 (a gossip separates friends; a violent person leads others astray).

floor.prerequisite: Knows the qualities of a good friend.
floor.question: Name one quality of a good friend.

representations: two paths: wise friends and foolish friends
steps: Choose friends who help you do right.
contexts: a new friend at a new school
a friend who helps you study

board.do: Draw two paths from one child.
Point at the path with wise friends.
board.say: What does Proverbs 13:20 say happens on this path?

board.do: Wait for the child to say you become wise.
Write the other two verses beside the paths.

misconceptions.repair: List qualities from Proverbs 13:20: walk with the wise. Ask what a friend helps you become.

listen_for: Bad company does not change a person
misconceptions.repair: Read 1 Corinthians 15:33 and give an example: a friend who swears, and soon you swear.

misconceptions.ask: What does Proverbs 16:28 say a gossip does?
misconceptions.repair: Read Proverbs 16:28: a gossip separates close friends. Act out a rumour spreading.

misconceptions.ask: What does Proverbs 13:20 say happens to one who walks with the wise?
misconceptions.repair: Read the verse in two halves and draw two paths: wise friends, wise; foolish friends, harm.

checks.question: What does a gossip do, according to Proverbs 16:28?
